user.title: Utility tracker – household
user.description: Name the household. Add utility accounts (electricity, gas) afterwards on the entry.

user.title: New account: name and utility
user.description: One account = one contract with one meter. An A1 and an H-tariff meter are two accounts.

data_description.nev: As shown on the panel, e.g. "Electricity A1".

szolgaltatas.title: Service – {nev}
szolgaltatas.description: Who bills you and with which tariff (the “Árszabás” line on the bill). Prices start from the supplier’s official rates and can be overridden later.

data_description.dijszabas: The "Árszabás" line on the bill: A1 general, H heat pump.
data_description.szolgaltato: The supplier shown in the invoice header (for electricity, the distribution area, e.g. MVM Démász).
data_description.dijszabas_tol: If you are not sure, leave it as is.

elszamolas.title: Billing – {nev}
elszamolas.description: Only the questions that apply to this tariff.

data.legterfogat: Heated air volume of the flat

data_description.elszamolas_mod: Self-reading: you report the meter monthly. Advance: fixed monthly quantity (or your reading if reported). Remote reading: smart meter, calendar months.
data_description.fizetesi_mod: For gas this also sets the discounted allowance. By consumption (self-reading, reading): the allowance is weighted by month (more in winter, less in summer – MVM table) and accumulates within the discount year (1 Aug – 31 Jul). Instalments (fixed monthly part bills, settlement at period end): yearly allowance.
data_description.idoszak_mod: Calendar month, or a custom start day as on the invoice (e.g. MVM gas: 14th to 13th → 14).
data_description.idoszak_nap: Only used with a custom start day.
data_description.keret_aktiv: Usually yes for electricity and gas.
data_description.szobaszam: Without a gas meter the monthly flat amount depends on rooms and cooker (MVM table, e.g. 2 rooms, 3–4 burners: 450 MJ/month). No meter data is needed.
data_description.tuzhely: Type of the gas cooker in the home.
data_description.legterfogat: Air volume (lm³) – on the bill the quantity of the base fee (e.g. „Alapdíj 118,30 lm3”). The heating and hot-water base fees are multiplied by it.
data_description.futes_gj_ho: The „Hődíj” quantity of a heating-season month on the bill (e.g. 2.0939 GJ).

mero.title: Meter – {nev}
mero.description: A starting meter reading is needed: e.g. the opening reading and date of the oldest bill you will upload.

data.kezdo_allas: Meter reading on the start date (optional)
data.almero: Garden sub-meter behind the main meter
data.almero_kezdo_allas: Sub-meter reading on the start date

data_description.beepitve: The day the reading below was valid. Do not use today if you upload older bills – readings before the start date are not imported.
data_description.gyari_szam: The long number at the start of the meter reading line on the bill.
data_description.kezdo_allas: The meter reading on the start date (the opening reading on the invoice). If left empty, it is taken from the sensor: from its Home Assistant statistics for the start date, otherwise from its current value – in that case cost tracking starts today. A manually entered value always takes precedence. An entered opening reading is the origin of the settlement: the settlement year starts here (until a later annual reading takes over), and it is listed among the meter readings as „Opening reading”.
data_description.forras_entitas: If you have a sensor that increases together with the meter (e.g. a Shelly energy meter), daily consumption comes from it. Without it, consumption is calculated from meter readings and invoices.
data_description.forras_tipus: Meter reading: the sensor value is the meter reading itself. Counter: only its change is used.
data_description.forras_szorzo: If the sensor consistently differs from the meter (e.g. 1.0412). Usually 1.
data_description.forras_korrekcio: Aligns the sensor with the real meter readings (invoices, submitted readings): estimates how many percent less or more it measures than the meter and corrects for it; manual offset adjustments (jumps) are not counted as consumption. Needs at least 3 readings over 45 days.
data_description.forras_tol: If the sensor's earlier data is wrong, data before this date is ignored.
data_description.profil_forras: With sparse (e.g. yearly) readings, consumption between two readings is split into months by this sensor's daily shape – e.g. gas estimated from boiler run time; the remainder (hot water, cooking) evenly. Affects only the yearly comparison chart.
data_description.h_teli_forras: If the winter and summer registers are also measured by separate sensors, set both – they are then calculated separately.
data_description.napelem_mod: Gross: monthly settlement, feed-in at the purchase price. Net: yearly netting.
data_description.betaplalas_entitas: Sensor of the energy fed back into the grid.
data_description.almero: Water from the irrigation sub-meter is deducted from the sewage fee.
data_description.gazmero_teljesitmeny: With the B1 tariff the annual standing charge (HUF 14,633 net) applies per m³/h – see the meter plate or the bill.
data_description.kozosseg_tipus: Condominium / housing cooperative: discounted allowance (flats + 1) × 63,645 MJ/year. Family community: flats × 63,645 MJ/year.
data_description.lakasszam: Number of separate flats on the shared gas meter.
data_description.a2_csucs_forras: A2 two-zone tariff: peak and off-peak are priced separately. With both register sensors they are measured separately. Without them the meter sensor above is split by its hourly statistics (off-peak: working days 22–06, 23–07 in summer time, weekends and public holidays all day); where hourly data is missing, it estimates from the share of hours. The 2,523 kWh allowance is shared.

szamlak.title: Bills and payment – {nev}
szamlak.description: Where the bills come from and how often.

data_description.szamla_merok: If one folder holds several accounts' bills (A1 and H), separate them by meter serial number. Empty: sorted by the bill's tariff (A1/H).
data_description.szamla_mappa: A folder inside the config folder where invoice PDF/XML files are stored (e.g. „Szamlak/Otthon_aram” or the Díjnet download folder). The list offers folders that already contain invoices; you can also type one.
data_description.dijnet_szolgaltato: Take payments from the paid invoices of the Díjnet integration.
data_description.szamlazas_honap: If empty, estimated from the invoices.
data_description.elszamolas_honap: E.g. DAKÖV: every six months; electricity, gas: yearly.
data_description.atalany_mennyiseg: E.g. 293 (kWh) – if empty, the quantity on the latest invoice applies.
data_description.reszszamla_osszeg: HUF; if empty, the amount of the latest partial invoice.
data_description.elozo_ev_mennyiseg: For forecasting the yearly balance when you do not yet have two settlement readings.
data_description.kovetkezo_eves_leolvasas: When moving in or starting mid-year: the expected day of the supplier's annual reading. The first year is a partial year up to this day. An invoice's announced reading date takes precedence.
data_description.diktalasi_ablak: Days of the month when the reading can be submitted (e.g. 8-14). Used until an invoice states the window.
data_description.hasznalat: Holiday home: seasonal use (much in summer, almost nothing in winter) – the yearly balance forecast follows this monthly distribution.
data_description.utalas_nap: If your bank pays the bill by a standing (scheduled) transfer on a given day of the month (e.g. 16): the bill counts as paid on the first such day after its issue date – moved to the next working day if it falls on a non-working day (weekend, holiday, transferred rest day), as banks do. In shorter months, the last day of the month. Manual and Díjnet payments take precedence.
data_description.szunetel_tol: If the service is suspended (e.g. the property is uninhabited after a death or a disaster, meter sealed): from this day nothing is calculated – no consumption, no standing charge, no per-invoice minimum – and no invoice is expected.
data_description.szunetel_ig: When the service resumes: the last day of the suspension, so the suspended period stays zero. Empty: still suspended.

error.teruleti_dijszabas: This tariff is not available with this supplier (distribution area): B Komfort only in the MVM Démász area, B GEO only in the ELMŰ and MVM Émász areas.

user.title: Off-grid system
user.description: Off-grid (or grid-backup / generator) energy system – kWh only, no costs. Consumption is always required; choose what else your system measures.

forrasok.title: Sensors – {nev}
forrasok.description: Cumulative energy counter(s) per role. W, A, V, SOC are not used.

data_description.forras_fogyasztas: Cumulative energy counter (kWh/Wh/MWh, total_increasing); several allowed – summed. Empty: manual readings (hu_rezsi.sziget_leolvasas).
data_description.forras_pv: Cumulative energy counter (kWh/Wh/MWh, total_increasing); several allowed – summed. Empty: manual readings (hu_rezsi.sziget_leolvasas).
data_description.forras_akku_toltes: Cumulative energy counter (kWh/Wh/MWh, total_increasing); several allowed – summed. Empty: manual readings (hu_rezsi.sziget_leolvasas).
data_description.forras_akku_kisutes: Cumulative energy counter (kWh/Wh/MWh, total_increasing); several allowed – summed. Empty: manual readings (hu_rezsi.sziget_leolvasas).
data_description.forras_halozat: Cumulative energy counter (kWh/Wh/MWh, total_increasing); several allowed – summed. Empty: manual readings (hu_rezsi.sziget_leolvasas).
data_description.forras_halozat_akku: Cumulative energy counter (kWh/Wh/MWh, total_increasing); several allowed – summed. Empty: manual readings (hu_rezsi.sziget_leolvasas).
data_description.forras_export: Cumulative energy counter (kWh/Wh/MWh, total_increasing); several allowed – summed. Empty: manual readings (hu_rezsi.sziget_leolvasas).
data_description.forras_generator: Cumulative energy counter (kWh/Wh/MWh, total_increasing); several allowed – summed. Empty: manual readings (hu_rezsi.sziget_leolvasas).
data_description.forras_egyeb_termeles: Cumulative energy counter (kWh/Wh/MWh, total_increasing); several allowed – summed. Empty: manual readings (hu_rezsi.sziget_leolvasas).

options.szamlalo: Increasing counter only (e.g. Shelly total energy)

leolvasas_rogzites.name: Record meter reading
leolvasas_rogzites.description: Manual or provider reading for an account's meter. Always overrides the automatic sensor.

elszamolasi.name: Billing (yearly) reading
elszamolasi.description: Starts the yearly allowance and splits the period here.

csatorna.name: Meter register
csatorna.description: For a bidirectional meter: import or export.

diktalt.name: Reported to the provider
diktalt.description: For self-reading electricity accounts: this reading was reported – the billing period ends here (the next starts the day after).

evkezdet.name: Start of settlement year
evkezdet.description: A new settlement year starts on this day (e.g. after a final invoice and new contract), even if it is closer than 10 months to another annual reading.

ido.name: Time
ido.description: Time of the reading. Empty: for today's own reading the moment of recording, for earlier days the start of the day.

leolvasas_torles.name: Delete reading
leolvasas_torles.description: Deletes all readings of a day from the account.

merocsere.name: Meter replacement
merocsere.description: Closes the current meter and opens a new one; consumption stays continuous.

csatorna.name: Meter register
csatorna.description: For a bidirectional meter: import or export.

visszavonas.name: Undo last meter change
visszavonas.description: Remove the meter added by the last change (if it has no readings yet).

feluliras.name: Override rate
feluliras.description: Custom value for a rate or rule from a date. Without a value the override is removed.

naplo.name: Get log
naplo.description: Closed periods, meters, readings and overrides of the account.

csv_export.name: CSV export
csv_export.description: Writes closed periods and readings to CSV in /config/hu_rezsi.

v1_import.name: Import from v1 package
v1_import.description: Copies the old YAML package's reading log and monthly bills. Dry run by default.

futoertek_rogzites.name: Record calorific value
futoertek_rogzites.description: Monthly calorific value from the gas bill (MJ/m³). Without value it is removed.

reszszamla_rogzites.name: Record partial bill
reszszamla_rogzites.description: Manually recorded paid partial bill (without Díjnet).

reszszamla_torles.name: Delete partial bill
reszszamla_torles.description: Delete a manually recorded partial bill of a day.

szamlak_ujraolvasasa.name: Re-read bills
szamlak_ujraolvasasa.description: Delete the bills, payments and meter readings imported from the bill folder, then re-read the whole folder. Manually recorded data is kept.

minden_meroallas.name: Delete all meter readings
minden_meroallas.description: Manually recorded meter readings are deleted too (all readings of the account).

fajlok.name: Only these files
fajlok.description: File names in the bill folder: only these are re-read, all other data stays.

szamla_rogzites.name: Record bill
szamla_rogzites.description: Enter a bill manually: payment, optionally the closing meter reading and calorific value – handled like a bill read from the folder.

kelte.name: Issue date
kelte.description: The day the bill was issued.

osszeg.name: Amount
osszeg.description: Gross amount payable (negative for a refund).

sztornozott.name: Cancelled invoice number
sztornozott.description: For a cancellation: the number of the invoice it cancels. The amount is the cancelled invoice's value – booked as a credit; no payment is due on the cancelled invoice.

idoszak_tol.name: Period start
idoszak_tol.description: First day of the billed period.

idoszak_ig.name: Period end
idoszak_ig.description: Last day of the billed period.

zaro_allas.name: Closing reading
zaro_allas.description: Closing meter reading on the bill (on the last day of the period, or the issue date).

leolvasott.name: Read by the provider
leolvasott.description: The closing reading was taken by the provider (not self-reported).

futoertek.name: Calorific value
futoertek.description: Gas: MJ/m³ for the months of the period.

hatarido.name: Payment due date
hatarido.description: The due date on the bill – if it passes and the bill is unpaid, the panel warns.

szamla_torles.name: Delete bill
szamla_torles.description: Delete a bill with its payment and meter readings.

sorszam.name: Number
sorszam.description: Number of the bill to delete.

szamla_feltoltes.name: Upload bill
szamla_feltoltes.description: Upload a PDF or XML bill to the account's bill folder and process it right away.

file_id.name: File
file_id.description: The bill as PDF or XML.

lezartak_ujraszamolasa.name: Recalculate closed periods
lezartak_ujraszamolasa.description: Recalculates and replaces the closed periods by the account's current billing method (e.g. reading periods), from the tariff start or the given date.

tol.name: From
tol.description: Empty: from the tariff start (earlier closings are kept).

szamla_osszevetes.name: Compare invoices with the calculation
szamla_osszevetes.description: Compares the account's real invoices (last n months) with the Rezsikövető calculation for each billed period, to the forint.

fiok_lezarasa.name: Close account (final settlement)
fiok_lezarasa.description: Moving out, cancellation or switching supplier: final reading on the given day, the account stops there, the last period is closed and the panel shows the final settlement. Can be undone.

datum.name: Closing date
datum.description: Day of the final reading (empty: today).

zaro_allas.name: Final meter reading
zaro_allas.description: Meter reading on the closing day.

visszavonas.name: Undo closing
visszavonas.description: Remove the closing and the final reading – the account runs again.

sziget_leolvasas.name: Off-grid: record reading
sziget_leolvasas.description: Cumulative energy counter value for one role (experimental, instead of a sensor).

mentes.name: Backup
mentes.description: Back up the utility tracker into a zip (config folder rezsikoveto_mentes/): household settings, readings, bill data, payments, closed periods and off-grid systems; optionally the bill PDFs.

szamlak.name: With bill files
szamlak.description: Include the PDF/XML files of the bill folders.

megtart.name: Backups to keep
megtart.description: Keep this many latest backups, delete older ones (0 = keep all).

visszaallitas.name: Restore
visszaallitas.description: Restore a backup – always as a new household (never overwrites; name clash gets '(visszaállítva)'). Backups from another Home Assistant work too.

fajl.name: Backup file
fajl.description: A file in the rezsikoveto_mentes/ folder.

file_id.name: Uploaded backup
file_id.description: Upload a zip (e.g. from another HA).

otthon.name: Household
otthon.description: Restore only this household (name in the backup); empty = all.

szamlak.name: With bill files
szamlak.description: Write back bill files from the backup (existing files are kept).

hely.name: Backup location
hely.description: Index of the backup location (0 = first).

init.title: Home settings
init.description: For the launcher card (custom:rezsikoveto-kartya): with a heating thermostat the card shows the indoor temperature inside the house and smoke from the chimney while heating; the outdoor temperature appears outside. Leave empty to show nothing for this home.

data_description.futes: Thermostat (climate): heating state (hvac_action: heating) and measured temperature; switch/binary sensor: on = heating.

hianyzo_forras.title: Rezsikövető: missing source sensor
hianyzo_forras.description: Rezsikövető receives no value from these entities: {entitasok}. Check that they exist and are available, or choose another sensor in the account settings. Until then the account is retried at the normal interval; this notice disappears automatically once a value arrives.
